tmdb.originalTitle: 秘境探検ファム＆イーリー

overview.value: Fam and Ihrie are ruin explorers, scraping out a living by digging relics from the ruins of a lost age when magic ruled the world. Ihrie is a formidable sorceress with a catch: a curse turns her into a small furry creature every time she casts a spell. Breaking it means finding the Ultimate Power, sealed behind three relics — and they're not the only ones hunting it. Rival treasure hunters, a prince whose kingdom was destroyed, and the dark sorcerer Ruguduroll are all after the same prize, in a comic fantasy adventure.

translations.title: Ruin Explorers Fam & Ihrie
translations.overview: Fam and Ihrie are ruin explorers, scraping out a living by digging relics from the ruins of a lost age when magic ruled the world. Ihrie is a formidable sorceress with a catch: a curse turns her into a small furry creature every time she casts a spell. Breaking it means finding the Ultimate Power, sealed behind three relics — and they're not the only ones hunting it. Rival treasure hunters, a prince whose kingdom was destroyed, and the dark sorcerer Ruguduroll are all after the same prize, in a comic fantasy adventure.

魔法が世界を支配していた古代文明の遺跡から遺物を発掘し、その日暮らしを続ける二人の「秘境探検家」、ファムとイーリー。イーリーは強力な魔導士でありながら、呪いによって魔法を使うたびに小さな毛玉のような獣に変えられてしまう。その呪いを解く鍵は、三つの遺物に封じられた「究極の力」。だがそれを狙うのは彼女たちだけではなかった。ライバルの探検家たち、祖国を滅ぼされた王子ライル、そして邪悪な魔導士ルグドロール――笑いと冒険が交錯する、ファンタジー・アドベンチャー。

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Map in hand, Fam and Ihrie go after the Proof of Royalty hidden in an ancient castle — running headlong into rival explorers Miguel and Rasha, and the thoroughly untrustworthy merchant Galuff. By the time the dust settles, they've learned the catch: the Ultimate Power takes three relics, not one.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: On the road, Fam meets Prince Lyle and promptly falls for him. In a ruined city the party runs into Ruguduroll — a sorcerer their attacks simply cannot touch. Lyle then reveals what's driving him: this is the man who destroyed his kingdom.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: On the road, Fam meets Prince Lyle and promptly falls for him. In a ruined city the party runs into Ruguduroll — a sorcerer their attacks simply cannot touch. Lyle then reveals what's driving him: this is the man who destroyed his kingdom.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Only someone whose wishes are free of self-interest can lay hands on the Sword of Sargus — and that turns out to be Fam. Then Ruguduroll strikes, making off with the relics they've gathered. In the chaos, one thread of hope surfaces: Ihrie's magic is the one thing that can wound him.
